title: Palm Tree
sourceLines: -Deborah led Israel from under a Jud 4:5
-In the temple seen in the vision of Ezekiel Eze 40:16; 41:18
-Branches of, thrown in the path when Jesus made his triumphal entry into Jerusalem Joh 12:13
-Jericho was called “The City of Palm Trees,” De 34:3
.Of the prosperity of the righteous Ps 92:12
.Used as a symbol of victory Re 7:9
